text:
sam_ae: Opening Oxide POC thread for performance + security checks. Customer acceptance: sustain 750 qps, p95 end-to-end < 130ms, and documented KMS/HSM behavior for audit/compliance. Need a concise runbook, quick cost delta for encryption, and artifacts for the AE pack.
anya_eng: Got it. Recommend model: rdx-6b-fp16 for headroom on 750 qps with lower CPU overhead vs fp32. We'll run on a dedicated cluster (no multi-tenant noise). Typical request avg tokens: 420 in + 160 out.
diego_sre: For 750 qps sustained I'd start with 12 nodes (estimate based on previous rdx-6b runs). Plan: 15m warmup with prefix & kv cache priming, then 40m steady-state, and a 10m step-down. We'll include a 10% burst to 1000 qps for 5m to test headroom.
sam_ae: Can you paste a simple load command and the metrics we'll return? I need something I can forward.
anya_eng: Load plan (summary): ramp 0->750 qps over 12m, sustain 40m, burst 5m @ 1000 qps, teardown 3m. Use Poisson arrivals, 30 clients spread across 3 generator boxes. Collect: p50/p90/p95/p99 latencies, server CPU/GPU utilization, kernel preempt metrics, and token/time cost.
anya_eng: Fortio smoke example (one-liner):
```
fortio load -qps=750 -t=40m -c=30 http://redwood-loadgen/oxide/v1/generate -payload=payload.json > fortio.out
```
I'll run 4 variants: baseline (no encryption), envelope cached, envelope no-cache, and with KMS roundtrip each request.
leo_security: KMS notes: customers using BYOK want unwrapped keys never leaving KMS. For POC we can show two modes: cached envelope keys (recommended for production perf) and strict unwrap-every-request (to show worst-case latency). We'll document key-rotation interval and audit event flow to their SIEM (CloudTrail/Splunk).
diego_sre: ci-bot: perf-job-oxide-4300001234 started on cluster-dedicated-7.
ci-bot: perf-job-oxide-4300001234: pre-warm started (scripts: warm_prefix.sh).
anya_eng: Early run (warm cache only): baseline p95 ~ 98ms, p99 ~ 220ms at 750 qps. Cached-envelope p95 ~ 120ms, p99 ~ 280ms. KMS-every-request p95 ~ 165ms, p99 ~ 420ms. GPU util avg 67% during steady state, CPU offload +14% with envelope ops.
sam_ae: Those numbers look promising. Diego, can you convert the perf impact into cost terms for the AE? They asked for $ impact per million requests and overall hourly cost for the POC.
diego_sre: Cost sketch: node price (example) $3.10/hr/node -> 12 nodes = $37.20/hr. Baseline token cost estimate: compute + infra -> ~$0.95 per 1M tokens (rough). Cached-envelope increases CPU/GPU work +16% -> ~+$0.15 per 1M tokens. KMS-every-request ~+40% -> ~+$0.38 per 1M tokens due to KMS latency and CPU load. I'll add a short table for AE.
leo_security: Draft FAQ entry for their security questionnaire: "Key ownership: customer-managed CMKs in their KMS. Redwood uses envelope encryption: ephemeral envelope keys are generated per-node and cached; unwrap operations are performed by the customer's KMS. All unwrap / key usage events are logged and forwarded to the customer's audit endpoint. Key rotation: envelope keys rotated every 24h by default; CMK rotations follow customer's KMS policies. For FIPS/HSM deployments we support on-prem HSM or cloud HSM (AWS CloudHSM / Azure Dedicated HSM) and can provide attestation artifacts."
anya_eng: ci-bot: perf-job-oxide-4300001234 completed. Artifacts: s3://perf-artifacts/oxide/4300001234/{fortio.out,cpu-gpu-metrics.tar.gz,run-report.html}
sam_ae: Action items: anya to upload abridged run-report + graph images for the AE pack, diego to produce cost addendum and hourly POC quote, leo to paste the QA snippet and confirm audit log forwarding instructions. I'll send to the customer after all three items land.
diego_sre: Warmup script we used: `./scripts/warm_prefix.sh --keys=20000 --clients=30 --duration=15m`
anya_eng: Notes for ops: enable envelope-cache=true in cluster config for the cached run: `env.ENVELOPE_CACHE_TTL=3600` and `KMS_WRAPPER=true` for BYOK path.
sam_ae: Thanks team. I'll mark this thread and ping if the customer requests additional headroom testing or HSM attestation docs. :thumbsup:
